paths.description: Canonical homepage: sole public entry template and primary search affordance.
Homepage under narrow viewport and user preference conditions.
Representative primary journey from a search query to results. Attempted because it is the core task and distinct results template.

findings.summary: Search navigation changes state abruptly without View Transition support.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS probe found no view-transition usage on the search entry surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-document search/state changes with document.startViewTransition(), preserving an immediate fallback.

findings.summary: The search journey presents a large cookie banner over the anti-bot challenge.
findings.evidence: Search-flow screenshot shows the cookie banner obscuring the lower portion of the required challenge.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-obscuring consent surface where lawful, and ensure required content and actions remain visible.

findings.summary: The consent overlay is implemented as generic div chrome rather than a semantic modal primitive.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse node path identifies body > div.gdpr-popup-v3-main; DOM inspection found zero dialog and popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for modal consent or popover for non-modal transient UI, with declarative dismissal and focus handling.

findings.summary: The page omits the viewport meta tag, so a 360px device receives a 980px layout scaled down to 0.367x.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout reports hasViewportMeta=false, layout viewport 980px and visual scale 0.367; the screenshot shows tiny controls and text.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and adapt the layout intrinsically at narrow widths without disabling zoom.

findings.summary: The central search component scales down with the desktop canvas instead of responding to its available container.
findings.evidence: CSS probe found zero container queries; at the 360px condition the browser renders a 980px layout and scales the search bar to a small strip.
findings.suggestedFix: Give the search component a containment context and use size container queries or intrinsic sizing to adapt spacing and controls.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visually indicated, and several controls are only 40px high.
findings.evidence: Active focus probe across 12 links, textareas, and buttons found outline-style:none and no box-shadow for every candidate; buttons measured 40-43px.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator and enlarge pointer targets to at least 44x44 CSS px without reducing visual clarity.

findings.summary: The primary content paints far outside the good LCP range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 7.7s and FCP 3.2s; the raw-CDP trace independently measured FCP/LCP about 5.02s.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten the redirect/document critical path, prioritize the LCP/search UI resources, and defer non-critical scripts.

findings.summary: Redirect and document latency delay a very small page.
findings.evidence: HAR reports two redirects, the main document taking 2.27s, and 29 requests/325.6KB transferred; Lighthouse attributes about 1.07s waste to redirects.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the canonical homepage directly, remove avoidable redirect hops, and defer non-critical identity/analytics requests.

findings.summary: A minimalist search page ships substantial unused JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports about 41KB, 30KB, and 26KB wasted in three bundles; HAR records 170.8KB of script transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split optional services, load them on intent, and remove duplicate or unused framework/application code from initial load.

findings.summary: The search combobox is missing required state semantics.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse axe audit flags textarea#text role=combobox without required aria-expanded.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose the combobox expanded state and keep aria-controls/active-descendant synchronized with the suggestions popup.

findings.summary: The search placeholder and consent link miss contrast requirements.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured the placeholder at 4.2:1 against #39393a (needs 4.5:1) and the consent link only 1.26:1 against surrounding text.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase foreground contrast and distinguish inline links with a non-color cue such as an underline.

findings.summary: Keyboard users receive no visible focus indication and the mobile rendering lacks a main landmark.
findings.evidence: Focus probe found no visible outline or shadow on any tested interactive element; Lighthouse also reports no main landmark in its mobile DOM.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide persistent :focus-visible styling, verify logical tab order, and ensure the primary content is contained in one <main>.

findings.summary: Text and controls become uncomfortably small on narrow screens.
findings.evidence: At 360x800, the absent viewport declaration causes the 980px desktop canvas to be scaled to 36.7%, visibly shrinking header and search text.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a device-width viewport and fluid type/spacing that remains comfortably legible without browser-level shrink-to-fit.

findings.summary: The mobile page relies on shrink-to-fit and includes sub-44px controls.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout reports no viewport meta and a 0.367 scale; interaction probe measures key buttons at 40-43px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Enable proper reflow with a device-width viewport, preserve user zoom, and expand touch target hit areas to 44px or more.

findings.summary: The page logs a CSP violation during load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured a blocked connection from sso.ya.ru/install to sso.passport.yandex.ru/beacon/report under connect-src self.
findings.suggestedFix: Align the SSO frame CSP with the intended beacon endpoint or remove the blocked request.

findings.summary: The page is ineligible for the back/forward cache and emits DevTools cookie issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three BFCache failure reasons involving Cache-Control:no-store and multiple cookie-related Inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Limit no-store to genuinely sensitive responses, avoid modifying cookies during unload/navigation, and resolve cookie policy warnings.

findings.summary: The homepage is blocked from indexing and lacks a mobile viewport declaration.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse is-crawlable score is 0 because robots.txt line 3 disallows /?; the layout probe reports hasViewportMeta=false.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow the canonical public homepage in robots.txt and add a device-width viewport meta tag.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are inconsistent and no sitemap is available.
findings.evidence: The canonical points to https://ya.ru/, but navigation redirects to a query URL covered by Disallow:/?; /sitemap.xml returned 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the canonical URL directly reachable and crawlable, avoid query redirects for the public entry page, and publish/reference a sitemap where appropriate.

findings.summary: The main document lacks baseline security headers and sets an insecure cookie.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive reports no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, framing, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; cookies reports sso_status without Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy; mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with deliberate SameSite scope.

findings.summary: The landing page establishes a broad, long-lived identifier and analytics footprint before interaction.
findings.evidence: Cookies primitive found 17 cookies, many SameSite=None and up to 400 days; tracker/network evidence shows five third-party origins and 18/29 requests (223.9KB) third-party.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize pre-consent identifiers, shorten retention, use same-site cookie scope where possible, and defer analytics/monitoring until needed and permitted.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are absent on the main document.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive found no HSTS, framing defense, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP, or nosniff header.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, CSP with frame-ancestors (and Trusted Types where applicable), nosniff, strict referrer policy, and least-privilege permissions policy.

findings.summary: The app-like search surface advertises a manifest but has no active service worker or offline fallback.
findings.evidence: PWA probe fetched the manifest successfully but navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() returned no registrations.
findings.suggestedFix: Register a small service worker that supplies an intentional offline search/home fallback and validates installability.

findings.summary: Third-party script and identity traffic is disproportionate to the minimal landing page.
findings.evidence: HAR shows 18 of 29 requests and 223.9KB of 325.6KB transferred are third-party; scripts alone transfer 170.8KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer analytics, SSO, and optional services until intent; reduce initial bundles and cache stable assets.

findings.summary: The search capability is not exposed as a structured agent tool.
findings.evidence: DOM/source probe found conventional forms and no WebMCP or agent-tool registration; discoverability content coverage is 0% despite a visually complete no-JS page.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer a narrowly scoped, permission-aware search tool via WebMCP/agentic forms while preserving the existing semantic form fallback.

taskList.title: Add baseline security headers and secure cookie policy
Restore mobile reflow, legibility, target sizes, and visible focus
Cut LCP by removing redirects and deferring optional JavaScript
Repair combobox ARIA and text/link contrast
Make the canonical homepage directly crawlable and publish consistent indexing signals
Resolve console, BFCache, and DevTools cookie issues
Add an offline fallback for the manifest-backed search app
Progressively enhance search transitions and agent capability discovery
